    - heading "Amazon EventBridge" [level=1]
    - paragraph: Build event-driven applications at scale across AWS, existing systems, or SaaS applications

    - heading "What is Amazon EventBridge?" [level=2]
    - paragraph: Amazon EventBridge is a serverless event broker that makes it easier to build event-driven applications at scale using events generated from your applications, integrated SaaS applications, and AWS services. Platform teams get centralized event routing across all AWS accounts in an organization with governance, observability, and ordering guarantees out of the box. Application developers get simplified subscriptions that combine filtering, target configuration, and retry policies in a single resource. With support for tens of thousands of subscribers per bus, up to 365 days of event retention, and multiple event formats including JSON, Avro, Protobuf, and Cloud Events, Amazon EventBridge reduces integration overhead so teams can ship faster.

limitations: Event sequence records provider receipt order; simultaneous browser causality is not inferred.
Network content is retained only when selected; response bytes are browser-decoded, not compressed wire bytes.
Request bytes are limited to what Playwright exposes; not_exposed does not establish body absence or multipart file coverage.
Network content reads settle within 5 seconds each and never wait for unfinished responses or refetch them.
Playwright scenario events do not expose request initiator stacks; receipt order does not prove causality.
Storage values are hashed only after declared-secret redaction.
